QuestInfo.name: Coney, Resident Genius
QuestInfo.0: It looks like the Papyrus Brothers want to deliver the #t4036142# items to someone for further study.
QuestInfo.1: The Papyrus Brothers want you to deliver a #t4036150# to a Shadowdealer named #bConey#k.\r\n#r#eNote:#n If you lose the quest item, you must forfeit the quest and accept it again.#k
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #t4036150# to Coney. He said it'll take some time to analyze it.

0.msg: Take this #t4036150# and deliver it to a Shadowdealer named #bConey#k.\r\n
#bConey#k's a really smart guy. Surprised you haven't met him. He signed on about the same time as you.\r\n

1.msg: He's a useful guy to know. You'll be glad you met him.\r\n

3.msg: Anyway, go deliver that to #bConey#k. After that, we'll have your next mission ready.\r\n

0.msg: What, do you have something more important to be doing?\r\n
C-c-cadena. Wh-what do you want? ...D-did I do something wrong?

1.msg: #b(You explain that the Papyrus Brothers want him to analyze the #t4036150#.)#k

2.msg: Oh, so that's why you're here. I th-th-thought it might be something else... Okay, I'll analyze the fur.\r\n

0.msg: There's d-d-definitely something odd about it... but I don't know wha-what it is, yet.\r\n

1.msg: Sorry, but I need some more time for the analysis. I'm v-v-very sorry.\r\n

2.msg: W-when I have the results... I-I'll contact you over the radio. I-I apologize in a-advance, truly.\r\n

3.msg: You're weird. Why do you apologize so much? You keep acting like some pitiful little underling and people will walk all over you.\r\n

4.msg: Well, uh, I... I d-don't think...um...

5.msg: #b(You've done what you came to. You should return to the Papyrus Brothers for your next mission.)#k

npc.0: Deliver the #t4036150# to a Shadowdealer named #bConey#k.\r\n

0.msg: #b(Huh? The #t4036150# is missing!)#k\r\n#rIf you have lost the item, you must forfeit the quest and then accept it again.
